findings.rule: Policy in force at incident date, premium paid, peril covered, in Australia
findings.explanation: The incident date falls inside the policy period, the premium was paid, the incident was in Australia and the peril is a collision on a COMP policy.

findings.rule: Claim notified within 30 calendar days of incident
findings.explanation: The claim was notified 1 day after the incident, within the 30-day window.

findings.rule: No alcohol, drug, licence, vehicle use, unlisted driver or registration exclusion applies
findings.explanation: The licence is valid, registration is current, use is private and the driver is the policyholder. No alcohol reading was recorded and no override was applied.

findings.rule: Handling track selection and precedence rules
findings.explanation: No triage or track-precedence clause was supplied. The claim was put on the FAST track despite an elevated fraud score of 40, so whether that track was right cannot be confirmed. POL-SLA-006:3.2 is the closest clause supplied.

findings.rule: Assessment requirement and type (POL-CLM-001 4.1 not supplied)
findings.explanation: The rule on when an assessment is required (POL-CLM-001 4.1) was not supplied. The claim was settled with no assessment despite photo-date and fraud concerns, so whether one was required cannot be confirmed.

findings.rule: Approver authority limits for the decision and payment (not supplied)
findings.explanation: No approval-authority matrix was supplied, so whether L1 may approve this decision and payment cannot be confirmed.

findings.rule: Fraud score calculation from the indicator catalogue; D-04 is not in the supplied catalogue
findings.calculation: C-04 = 5 points; D-04 points not in supplied clauses; recorded 40 implies D-04 = 35 (unverifiable)
findings.explanation: The D-04 points value is not supplied, so the recorded score of 40 cannot be verified. The handler notes also record photo metadata 11 days before the incident, which may be an unscored indicator. Enhanced verification was done on 17 September, within 10 business days, for an elevated-band score. Whether the score and referral were correct depends on the missing indicator rules.

findings.rule: PHOTOS must be at least four photographs within 7 days

evidence.value: Photo metadata shows images captured 11 days before the reported incident date. Enhanced verification completed 17 September. Claimant described the claims process in unusual detail.

findings.calculation: Photos captured 11 days before the incident vs 7-day requirement
findings.explanation: The PHOTOS code is on file, but the metadata shows the images were taken 11 days before the incident, outside the 7-day requirement. Whether this makes the document invalid needs review. Separately, POLICE_EVENT is required for collisions under clause 4.1, which was not supplied. The police event number is null and the incident is a collision, so whether it was required cannot be confirmed.

findings.rule: Fast-track decision within 5 business days; acknowledgement, communication and payment timeframes
findings.calculation: Decision 3 bd <= 5; ack 1 bd <= 2; payment 2 bd <= 10
findings.explanation: The decision, acknowledgement and payment were all within the supplied timeframes.

findings.rule: Net payment equals gross settlement less excess and GST/ITC deduction
findings.explanation: The excess applied equals the basic excess, the claimant is not GST-registered and the net paid is correct. No total loss or recovery applies.
